name: size
label: Size
description: Sets the input size

name: type
label: Type
description: Type of calendar to use with the form field

name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: Select to prevent the user from interacting with the field or changing its value

name: readonly
label: Read only
description: Select to make the field read-only and prevent users from modifying the value

name: autofocus
label: Auto-focus
description: Select to automatically place the focus inside the input on page load

name: value
label: Value
description: Value of the input field. Unless the input field has pre-populated data, leave this property empty

name: manageValue
label: Manage value
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the value property. Use the value set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: name
label: Identifier
description: Name of the input field

name: placeholder
label: Placeholder text
description: Placeholder text for the input field that helps the user understand what input is expected

name: label
label: Label
description: Label describing the overall purpose of the select field

name: wrapLabel
label: Wrap label
description: Wraps the label if it does not fit on one line

name: required
label: Required
description: Select to indicate that the field is required

name: hideRequiredIndicator
label: Hide required indicator
description: When true, the required indicator is hidden. Use this for forms where most fields are required along with the `optional` flag for any fields that are not required

name: optional
label: Optional
description: Select to indicate that the field is optional

name: helperContent
label: Helper content
description: If set, an information icon with popover text appears next to the field label to display help text to the user. Use plain text to allow for translation. If you don't want to add helper content, leave this property empty

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: When true, indicates that the field is in an incorrect state, which is reflected in the field display

name: manageInvalid
label: Manage invalid
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the invalid property. Use the invalid set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: messages
label: Alert messages
description: Array of inline alert messages that display below the field

name: format
label: Format pattern
description: Format of the date and time input value. Based on the Unicode Technical Standard (UTS)

name: opened
label: Opened
description: Flag that indicates whether the calendar is open (true) or closed (false)

name: manageOpened
label: Manage opened
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the opened property. Use the opened set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: footerActions
label: Footer actions
description: Array of objects that define the buttons that appear in the calendar footer

name: showDefaultFooterActions
label: Show default footer actions
description: Select to show default footer actions

name: hideFooter
label: Hide footer
description: Select to remove the footer from the calendar panel

name: hideAdjacentDates
label: Hide adjacent months
description: When true and `type` is `'date'`, the calendar doesn't show dates outside the displayed month

name: panelFitProps
label: Panel fit props
description: Keys to set to configure the calendar picker

name: weekdayHeadings
label: Day of week headings
description: Configures the length of the weekday headings

name: firstDayOfWeek
label: First day of week
description: Sets the first day of the week on the calendar panel

name: disableWeekends
label: Disable weekends
description: Select to turn off weekend days. Weekend days are determined by the `weekendDays` property

name: weekendDays
label: Weekend days
description: Sets which days are weekend days. Defaults to `6` (Saturday) and `0` (Sunday)

name: disabledItems
label: Disabled items
description: Array of objects representing dates that can't be selected. These dates must be string values that match the specified `format` property

name: configAria
label: ARIA properties
description: ARIA properties that are set on inner html. See https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/example-index/combobox/combobox-datepicker.html for properties and accepted values

name: initialTime
label: Default time
description: Configures the initial time for the date-time format

name: isoWeek
label: ISO calendar
description: Select to have the date calculation account for an ISO week. Defaults the first day of the week to Monday

name: align
label: Text align
description: Text alignment within an input field

name: fieldLayout
label: Field layout configuration
description: Configuration for the field layout. Determines whether the labels, fields, and slotted content are arranged vertically or horizontally, and their respective proportion in a horizontal container

name: defaultFooterActionLabels
label: Default footer action labels
description: Allows for custom naming of default footer action buttons

name: yearRange
label: Year range
description: Configures the range of years visible in the calendar. Can either be relative to the current year, or an absolute range. Note: years can be input in the field even if outside of this range
